description: This Scala source file defines the HistoryAppStatusStore class, which extends AppStatusStore and adds functionality for handling executor log URLs within Apache Spark's history server component.

classes.name: HistoryAppStatusStore
classes.description: A class that manages application status storage with custom executor log URL handling for Spark's history server.

methods.name: executorList
methods.description: Returns a list of executor summaries, optionally replacing log URLs if configured.

methods.name: executorSummary
methods.description: Returns a summary of a specific executor, with log URLs replaced if applicable.

methods.name: replaceLogUrls
methods.description: Replaces log URLs in an executor summary using the log URL handler.

methods.name: replaceExecutorLogs
methods.description: Creates a new ExecutorSummary with updated log URLs.
